leah: Quick Q2 milestone sync — TL;DR: shipped: model-routing canary, new batching defaults. slipped: persistent KV cache rollout, dedicated autoscaler polish. Owners below, please correct if I'm wrong. Next steps: unblock CRs, finalize rollout playbook by Wed, and schedule canary postmortem. Ping owners: @jamie (eng-runtime), @pranav (eng-ml), @olga (product-ops), @tony (eng-platform).

jamie: Thanks — short notes from runtime: canary telemetry looks good (p95 latency +2ms), but we hit a memory cliff on longer seqs with current kernel. I'll drop a patch today.

pranav: KV cache slipped because SRE needs the custom image w/ kernel flags. Blocker: infra image build stuck on internal signing. PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/4321. CC @tony for image pipeline.

tony: Acknowledged — I'm triaging the signing pipeline. ETA for image cut is EOD tomorrow if no further infra approvals. Also we need a small config change in helm values: `cache.enabled=true` -> `cache.enabled: auto` for staged rollout.

olga: I can own the rollout playbook + alert checklist. Need a short list of metrics and an SLO target to include. Proposed thresholds: error rate <0.5%, p95 latency <200ms, cache hit rate >60%. Thoughts? :thinking_face:

jamie: Those thresholds look sensible to me. For canary, we'll run 5% traffic for 24h then evaluate. I also want a strict CR gate: two approvers from eng-runtime + eng-ml.

leah: OK — action items (brief):
- pranav: unblock infra PR or hand to eng-platform (due Tue)
- jamie: drop runtime patch and add CR label `canary-ready` (due Tue)
- olga: draft playbook + alerts doc (due Wed)
- tony: finalize image cut + helm tweak (due EOD tomorrow)

pranav: quick FYI — to unblock faster you can run this locally to validate image signature: `./tools/verify-signature.sh build/image.tar` — saved us time last week.

jamie: CR ping @pranav and @tony for review: https://github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/987 — small kernel selection change.

olga: I'll schedule the canary readiness call Thu 10am and invite ops/SRE + product.

deploy-bot: Canary started for model-routing on cluster-prod-canary at 2024-05-02T14:30Z — traffic=5% — monitor: https://dashboards.redwood.com/canary/1716504321

leah: Great. If anyone needs help with unblock let me know. Please react with :thumbsup: when your action item is in progress.

jamie: :thumbsup: starting patch now.

pranav: :eyes: pushing fixes to infra PR, will request review in 30m.

tony: :shipit: working image cut now, will confirm when done.

olga: Added draft playbook (internal doc link) and started alert runbook. Will post link here once polished.

leah: Thanks all — we'll reconvene async unless anything breaks.
